analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md in two places. The first bumps the 'Last updated' date on line 3 from 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-24. The second corrects a documented source path on line 609: GatedDelta.swift moves from libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/ to libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLMCommon/. The patch is documentation-only, so there is no executable behavior, authorization, attestation, encryption, billing, or data-exposure change. I read the surrounding text, which describes the Nemotron Super slot, prefix-cache bank sizing, media admission, and GLM5Next, and found no new security claim in the changed lines. The path edit does not alter prefix-cache scoping, T-041 properties (HMAC-keyed names, 30-minute TTL, coordinator-authored cache scope), or the recurrent-state checkpoint claim that the doc cross-references. Residual question: the diff does not show the actual source move, so the new path in the doc is unverified here. If the kernel file was moved or refactored in this PR, that code lives in another batch and needs separate review, especially because the doc says the selected kernel matches the stock kernel bit for bit, which the prefix-checkpoint capture relies on. This is a coverage limit and not a finding.
